title: GPUStack Kubernetes proxy omits cluster authorization checks
summary: A non-admin user can access an unauthorized Kubernetes cluster through GPUStack's API proxy. Requests use a worker ServiceAccount and can expose resources or create workloads within its permissions.

severity.rationale: Authenticated users can cross cluster authorization boundaries and potentially execute code by creating workloads. The common cluster-use prerequisite and credential exposure warrant 72 hours.

exposure: Requires a Kubernetes-provider cluster and a reachable worker. The worker ServiceAccount permissions bound what the caller can read, change or delete.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade gpustack to 2.2.2 or later. Until then, restrict the instance to trusted administrator accounts.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed version and the component used by running processes meet the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
